description.describe_ch: 建立行銷資料科學及AI大數據行銷的觀念，並使用科學工具觀察行銷模型。學生能夠在課程中了解行銷數據的取得方式，並理解AI演算機制的原理。本課程將介紹資訊科學相關的應用工具，實際使用工具觀察並建立行銷模型，整合行銷模型及數位行銷應用。學生將以分組報告及研究報告方式，將理論與實務以專案方式實作。
description.describe_eh: Establish the concept of marketing data science and AI big data marketing, and use scientific tools to observe the marketing model. Students will be able to understand how to obtain marketing data and understand the principles of AI calculation mechanism in the course. This course will introduce application tools related to information science, actually use tools to observe and build marketing models, integrate marketing models and digital marketing applications. Students will use group reports and research reports to implement theory and practice in a project-based way.

targets.describe_ch: 能理解行銷資料科學、AI/大數據行銷、以及用戶行為分析的知識
targets.describe_en: Comprehension for the knowledge of marketing data science, AI/big data marketing, and user behavior analysis.

targets.describe_ch: 能分析行銷資料科學、AI/大數據行銷、以及用戶行為分析的行銷模型
targets.describe_en: To analyze the marketing models of marketing data science, AI / big data marketing, and user behavior analysis.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1. 專題報告 I：以問卷調查及數據分析技巧，進行品牌、客群分析洞察，主要使用工具：SPSS，占40%。
  2. 專題報告 II：以行銷數位工具、數據分析、競品分析、社群流量、關鍵字分析應用、客戶模型，進行品牌、客群分析洞察。主要使用工具：Python或EXCEL，占40%。
  3. 上課參與及出席：上課參與及出席 20%。
gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
Project Report I: Conduct brand and customer segment analysis using questionnaire surveys and data analysis techniques. The primary tool used: SPSS. Weight: 40%.
Project Report II: Perform brand and customer segment analysis through digital marketing tools, data analysis, competitor analysis, social media traffic, keyword analysis applications, and customer modeling. The primary tools used: Python or Excel. Weight: 40%.
Class Participation and Attendance: Class participation and attendance: 20%.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. 習慣性遲到、中途離開、早退的同學請勿修習本門課程，點名未到無特殊原因，視同三節未到，點名分數規定請查閱評分原則。
2. 依本系規定為12堂缺課(不含請假及特殊原因)即不及格。
3. 課程進度或規定，會因制度或其他因素小幅修改，修改前都會先通知同學。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
1. Students who habitually arrive late, leave midway, or leave early are advised not to enroll in this course. Absence from roll call without a valid reason will be counted as three missed sessions. Please refer to the grading policy for roll call score regulations.
2. According to department regulations, students who miss 12 sessions (excluding approved leave and special circumstances) will fail the course.
3. The course schedule and regulations may be slightly adjusted due to institutional policies or other factors. Any changes will be communicated to students in advance.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
1. 本課程因有連貫性學習內容，為免同學銜接不上影響其他同學，會實施常態點名，若無特殊理由缺課超過12節以上即會通知預警，請修課同學選課時確認自己的學習態度後再選課。
2. 請修課同學務必注意：第一堂課程會介紹課程概要及授課教師連貫性各階段的數位資訊行銷教學安排(大二~研究所)，若第一週(已選課、欲加選同學等)、第二週(加選同學第一週衝堂者)未能出席者，請勿選修本課程。
3. 若習慣缺課，修課中離席者，無法配合課程要求之同學，為維持教課品質及上課同學權益，請勿修習本課程。
4. 有意願加選同學，第一週請務必到課，課程說明只會於第一週說明一次，以免影響其他同學權益。
5. 本課程會實務操作數位行銷內容，建議有筆記型電腦的同學可以帶著隨課備用。
7. 本課程內容(上學期)偏向於介紹數位行銷操作內容及中階概念為主，下學期「數位行銷策略與工具」課程偏向於真正動手操作行銷數據工具、建立數位行銷之SEO實作、GA操作及實作、社群經營、客戶分析、文案撰寫、商品上架販售，學習使用行銷統計數據模型分析、AI應用分析、擬定行銷策略等，實務將與大學部共同參與數位行銷專題，並由專案實際進行數據分析以達成實際轉換，上學期著重於觀念、下學期著重於由概念衍生之進階實作，建議有志於電商、數位行銷、行銷數據分析同學上下學期均修習本系列課程。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
1. Due to the continuous learning content of this course, in order to prevent students from being unable to connect and affecting other students, regular roll call will be implemented. If you are absent from class for more than 12 periods without special reasons, you will be notified as an early warning. Students taking the course are asked to confirm their registration when selecting courses. Choose a course after learning the attitude.
2. Students taking this course must pay attention: the first course will introduce the course outline and the instructor’s continuity of digital information marketing teaching arrangements for each stage (sophomore ~ ​​graduate school). etc.), those who are unable to attend the second week (optional students who attend class in the first week) are not allowed to take this course.
3. Students who are habitually absent from class, leave during class, or cannot meet the course requirements, in order to maintain the quality of teaching and the rights of classmates, please do not take this course.
4. If you are willing to add students, please be sure to attend class in the first week. The course description will only be explained once in the first week to avoid affecting the rights of other students.
5. This course will cover practical aspects of digital marketing. It is recommended that students who have laptops bring them along with them during class.
7. The content of this course (in the first semester) focuses on introducing digital marketing operation content and intermediate concepts. In the next semester, the "Digital Marketing Strategies and Tools" course focuses on truly hands-on operation of marketing data tools and establishment of SEO implementation for digital marketing. GA operation and implementation, community management, customer analysis, copywriting, product sales, learning to use marketing statistical data model analysis, AI application analysis, formulating marketing strategies, etc. Practitioners will participate in digital marketing topics with the university department, and Conduct data analysis from the actual project to achieve practical transformation. The first semester focuses on concepts, and the next semester focuses on advanced implementation derived from concepts. It is recommended that students who are interested in e-commerce, digital marketing, and marketing data analysis take this series in both semesters. course.
